g.text: Full and append use exactly the same 16,384 history + 1,024 new tokens. Cold full uses a separate cache salt; append uses the warmed salt.

g.text: At batch 0, panel A measures a standalone prefill step. At positive batches it measures prefill mixed with B decode sequences; controls have no prefill.

g.text: Means and sample SD across five repeats. Model wall time includes engine/host work; TTFT also includes request handling. Not original-paper numerical replication.
